item: R61 slice 2 (item 12): Settings, Data and backup gains a Differences from restores panel listing the other values a restore kept, grouped by restore, with the local and imported value side by side, their provenance in words, and Keep both, Discard the restore's value and a per-restore discard
summary: Endpoints GET /api/backup/alternates and POST keep|discard and batch discard. The local side is found by identity (newest row), never by the stored id. There is deliberately no action that makes an imported value the shown one (the ruling: imported never prevails): a swap was built, an Opus review found six defects in it, and it was taken out; it can return as its own slice if asked. 34 strings x12; walked in Chromium in English and Arabic.
